notes.title: Small Bugfix - The Adventure Begins!
notes.notes: Just a small bug fix for an issue which was brought to my attention.  it was possible to get 'The Adventure Begins' without starting an adventure, if you had not picked an Heirloom.  The call to unlock it was before the check to see if the warning screen should be brought up, and has been moved to after this call to ensure it comes up as expected from now on.

notes.title: Minor Bug Fix – Health Display
notes.notes: Bug Fix – The health numbers on your character sheet were not updating as expected alongside the health boxes when you used medical supplies.  This has been corrected.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 6
notes.notes:
Red Ripper is proving to be one of the toughest challenges in the series to date.  As such, it is very likely that you will see the general death page many, many times before you defeat the terrible evil facing the Sunlight Alliance.  As with previous releases, the final page previewed before the game goes live is the death art, which you can find below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/b43fb93fee0b63dfa55927e5871da6a1a2306987.jpg[/img]

While not an official part of The Stasis, if a person of note dies they are often commemorated with a small shrine or ossuary where they fell.  This means they remain dead in the same place, this preserving continuity in future years.  As a visitor to the Sunlight Alliance, you will be afforded this dubious honour...even though you are a godless heathen in the eyes of the sainted nobility.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 5
notes.notes:
Here is the penultimate Red Ripper page, and the last of the general art images.  After this there is is only...death.  Followed, of course, by the release of the game.  Dare you brave this darkness to face the Red Ripper?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/27be89fd0c4b7463314153f769f2d3cf561251d9.jpg[/img]

Darkness quickly becomes a constant in a hunter's life.  Few of their foes lurk in the bright light of day, or move among the regular folk on the surface.  It was for this reason that, when the Hunter's Clubs were initially formalised, several voices called for their members to be named 'Torchbearers' or 'Light-Bringers'.  In the end these titles were dropped, although it is still the duty of the hunters to bring the light of reason to the darkest of places.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 4
notes.notes:
With a little under a week to go before Halloween, and the release of The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper, here is the latest of the general art pages for people to enjoy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/b27654a0d4e1b4c9cc4ad55f793f2a28598cacf5.jpg[/img]

Roche Divine embodies the terrible dichotomy of the the Sunlight Alliance.  In the halls of the Sainted Nobility, everything is of the highest quality, gilded excessively and polished to a high sheen.  This luxury is only maintained by the majority of the populace living in conditions of utter, abject poverty.  The worst part is that, thanks to centuries of The Stasis, the people not only believe this to be their natural state, but actively oppose any attempt to improve their lot.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 3
notes.notes:
Grindwheel Games welcomes you to the weekend with the third general page image from the upcoming Red Ripper.  We hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/1c59b5f4d07c2966173e8214c71fda4ca99100c3.jpg[/img]

Compasses are a rare sight in the Sunlight Alliance, as there is little need for them.  Under The Stasis, people are either expected to stay put, or the symbolic journey they must take is already so well known to them such tools are not needed.  Surviving examples are traded on the black market by members of the Heretics, and possession of one is considered suspicious by the Inquisitors.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 2
notes.notes:
Good morning!  It is Wednesday, which means it is time for another art page to be released.  Please enjoy the image and lore below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/71283487186008b342ebe391f17dc16c0ab348d9.jpg[/img]

It is, perhaps, a testament to the skill and artistry of the pre-Stasis Alliance that so many mundane objects have survived the ravages of time.  This doll, for example, was fabricated at the renowned Herballien boutique some time before the Sunset Rebellion.  The workers at the present factory are barely able to produce simple rag figures due to both a shortage of materials and poor training.  But, as dictated by The Stasis, they must continue to churn out such shoddy work as if their very souls depend on it.

notes.title: In-Game Art Release 1
notes.notes:
The Hunter's Journals - Red Ripper releases on Halloween.  With a little over a fortnight to go, it is time to preview the amazing in-game artwork by Muthur Brine, and build the lore of the sinister place you will be visiting.  Please enjoy the first page below, and be ready for more to follow.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37985104/4a41d8aa6763f0cc641cd3b9b83c2d067adea730.jpg[/img]

Items crafted before the imposition of The Stasis are considered by the Sunlight Alliance to be almost divine in nature.  Here we see a single bead from a ceremonial rosary, which has been strung on a cord made of ancient threads.  The peasants of the Alliance believe such trinkets bring great fortune and divine favour.
